from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted record of a single legal document for case cause analysis."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the legal document")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The document type, e.g., 判决书，裁定书，决定书，通知书")
    case_category: str = Field(description="The case category, e.g., 刑事，民事，行政，国家赔偿")
    charge_or_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific criminal charge or cause of action named in the text, e.g., 故意伤害罪，滥用职权罪")
    category_classification: str | None = Field(description="If the text explicitly states the broader crime classification chapter, e.g., 侵犯公民人身权利、民主权利罪，渎职罪")
    anchor_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt supporting the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocumentRecord]
